_README: Destination-specific facts used by xrefs.py when it resolves a cross-reference. Every entry is
VERIFIED against the product code at the revision named below and cites file and lines, or it is
not in this file at all. Nothing here is inferred from the manuals.
A destination absent from this file gets NO generated field list or screen claim - the adaptation
says only what the manual's own section heading establishes, and marks the rest unresolved. The
Crewing screens (Appraisals, Crew Promotion, the Annual/Periodic/Monthly/Other/Summary drug &
alcohol tests, and the Recruited/Waitlist/Rejected crew lists) are not in any repository available
here, so their field lists cannot be verified and must not be invented.
CORRECTED 22-Sep-2026 after the reviewer read the code block I had shipped: it was the LOCATION
view (data-testid stores-loc-*), it includes an 'All Categories' filter I had missed, and filters
must be stated PER VIEW, not as one flat list. Surveys' editable fields are now listed because the
pasted Certificates steps name 'Issue Date', which Surveys does not have.
Keys are matched case-insensitively against the destination sub-module name that xrefs.py derives

filters_by_view.Inventory (default): Vessel selector, Search, All Categories, Stock - Stores.tsx:2772-2829 (the viewMode === "inventory" branch)
filters_by_view.Location: Vessel selector, Search, All Categories, Stock, plus a 'Search locations...' panel - Stores.tsx:2694-2767 (data-testid stores-loc-search / stores-loc-category-filter / stores-loc-stock-filter) and :2934

stores.filters_evidence: one component serves the Stores, Lubes, Chemicals and Others tabs (activeTab); the filter bar is not gated by activeTab, so the per-view sets above apply to all four tabs. The same component serves the Office and Vessel manuals; 'criticality' and 'rotation' occur 0 times anywhere in Stores.tsx
stores.export: Stores exports from its own screen to stores_<tab>_inventory_<timestamp>.xlsx and stores_<tab>_history_<timestamp>.xlsx
stores.bulk_update: Bulk update stays inside Stores: the '+ Bulk Update <Stores/Lubes/Chemicals/Others>' button (the label follows the selected tab; the manual prints it as '+ Bulk Updates Store') opens Stores' own full-screen bulk-update page. There, choose 'Consume' or 'Receive' in the transaction-mode selector, enter the quantities per location (for Receive, the received date/place fields apply to all rows), click 'Save Updates', then 'Confirm & Save'. The Spares sub-sub-module is NOT opened at any point; Spares has its own separate bulk-update page. Both bulk-update pages need the PMS admin permission on the server (code-derived; the manual states no role)
